title: 2016 AMC 12B Problem 2
statement: The harmonic mean of two numbers can be computed as twice their product divided by their sum. The harmonic mean of \(1\) and \(2016\) is closest to which integer?

solutions.text:
The harmonic mean is \(\dfrac{2\cdot1\cdot2016}{1+2016}=\dfrac{4032}{2017}.\) Since \(\dfrac{2016}{2017}\) is very close to \(1,\) this is just under \(2,\) so the closest integer is \(2.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Twice the product over the sum: \(\dfrac{2\cdot1\cdot2016}{1+2016}\)
\(\dfrac{4032}{2017}\) is just a hair under a whole number; round it
